# Clinical Trials

Thank you for considering enrolling a pet in a clinical trial at Cornell. By participating, you are helping us to advance the health and well-being of animals and people.

Join our mailing list! Sign up to be notified of new clinical trials.

## Cornell Veterinary Clinical Trials

 

### Canine

  * A New Drug for Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Dogs

  * Radiofrequency Therapy for Pain Management in Dogs
  * Smart-Start Therapy for Canine B-Cell Lymphoma
  * Studying Electrophysiology of the Sinus Node in Dogs who Need Pacemakers
  * Traditional Versus Laparoscopic Castration in Dogs

### Canine, Equine

  * Stem Cell Therapy in Dogs and Horses
  * Stem Cell Therapy in Dogs and Horses

### Feline
